# Content Segment Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContentSegmentType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The structural type of a content segment — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Chapter, section, scene, and paragraph are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the segment-kind axis — the open set of individuals (chapter, section, scene, paragraph, front matter, …) that [`gmeow:segmentType`](../properties/gmeow-segmentType.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a kind not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a segment-kind SUBCLASS of [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — no overtyping); a new kind is always a fresh [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) individual, never a class.

### How to use

- Add a new kind as a [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from a segment via the functional [`gmeow:segmentType`](../properties/gmeow-segmentType.md).

### Examples

- ex:segmentTypeAct a [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "act"@en.
